description: Activate when the user types "/learn" or "/learn <topic>". This switches Claude Code into a teaching-first coding mode for unfamiliar technologies. Do NOT trigger on any other signal — only the explicit /learn command. Once activated, stay in this mode for the remainder of the conversation unless the user says "/learn off".
